## Feature Request

**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. I'm always frustrated when [...]

**Describe the solution you'd like**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

**Use case**
Describe the use case(s) where this feature would be valuable. Who would benefit from this feature?

**Additional context**
Add any other context, mockups, or screenshots about the feature request here.

**Provider Impact**
- [ ] This affects a specific provider (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, etc.)
- [ ] This is a general feature that works across all providers

**Surface Impact**
- [ ] CLI
- [ ] Web UI
- [ ] API
- [ ] Desktop App

---

**Checklist:**
- [ ] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/owenservera/vivim-final/issues) to make sure this feature has not already been requested.
- [ ] I have checked the [documentation](https://github.com/owenservera/vivim-final/blob/master/docs/USER-GUIDE.md) to see if this feature already exists.
- [ ] I am using the latest version of Vivim.
